scope_note: General-purpose AI system obligations. Fields map to DataHub customProperties under the agentguard.eu_ai_act namespace.
known_limitations: agentguard.eu_ai_act.disclosure_compliant is inferred from an asset's toolset: 'not_applicable' where no tool addresses a human, 'false' where a human-facing channel exists with no declared disclosure. Set disclosure_declared on an asset to record that the obligation is met. AgentGuard cannot verify the content of a disclosure.
Risk categories are derived from AgentGuard's own scoring, not from an Annex III legal assessment. This is a triage floor for a compliance officer, not a determination.

assets.name: Ghost MCP
findings: No accountable owner registered (Art. 26 human oversight cannot be assigned).

Served tool definitions carry hidden instructions (concealment, credential_exfiltration, instruction_override) — the documented purpose of the system does not match what it instructs the model to do (Art. 13).
Unauthenticated access to filesystem,system,credentials,messaging.
Reachable but unsupervised (no_health_endpoint): no operational logging (Art. 12).
Can spawn agents inheriting the caller's configuration: effective reach is 11 data sources, not 5.
assets.required_action: Quarantine before use: remove the poisoned tool definition and re-approve the server.
